description: Submit up to 50 image generations in one call. Asynchronous: returns a batch_id and a job id per item; poll get_batch, then get_job per image. Every item bills at the normal rate, so check get_balance first. Corent picks the model per item; pin one with generate_image instead. No reference images here.

items.description: One image in the batch. Corent picks the model for each item: to pin an exact model, use generate_image.

max_cost_cents.description: The most this may cost, in cents. Set it when the user gives a budget or a price limit. Refused before anything is spent when no model fits under it, and never exceeded.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model.

name: generate_image_batch
title: Generate many images (batch)
